name: Forsaken Shadows
detailed_description:
A fractured mind. A forgotten past. A horrifying truth waiting in the dark.

David wakes up in complete isolation — inside a decommissioned underground facility where the silence feels intentional and the shadows seem to whisper.
No memories. No answers.
Just questions… and a name that echoes through his thoughts: Project Umbra.

As flickering lights cast long silhouettes and reality begins to distort, David sets out to uncover the truth.
Who is he?
Why was he chosen?
And who is Dr. Claire H. Winterfeldt — the psychiatrist whose voice lingers deep within his mind?

🧠 A Psychological Descent

Forsaken Shadows isn't about monsters hiding under the bed.
It's about the ones hiding in your head.
A haunting exploration of control, memory, and identity — where the boundaries between self and experiment begin to blur.

🔦 Key Features:

  • Atmospheric first-person psychological horror with a strong narrative focus

  • Light-based exploration through a deeply reactive and eerie environment

  • Dual-world gameplay: shift between distorted realities and uncover layered truths

  • Environmental storytelling via documents, voice logs, and hallucinations

  • No combat – no comfort: your greatest weapon is your mind

  • Built with Unreal Engine 5: immersive lighting, detailed level design, and cutting-edge visuals

Forsaken Shadows isn’t just a horror game. It’s an experience about facing your inner demons, embracing the fear—and discovering who you truly are.

Some memories don’t fade. Some shadows never leave.

English*, German
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headset required, Designed for 1080p at medium to high settings with 60 FPS. An SSD is strongly recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headset required, Designed for 1080p at medium to high settings with 60 FPS. An SSD is strongly recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: Please note that some characters in this game are depicted in revealing or suggestive clothing. These characters are purely fictional and do not resemble any real individuals. The game may also include mature themes that could be disturbing to some players, such as sexual content. Players are advised to approach the content with caution if they are sensitive to these themes.
